Faq.title: Everything You Need to Know
Faq.subtitle: Manage inventory, track buyer inquiries, and stay in control with a single, easy-to-use dashboard.

q1.question: How does RutaRide verify listings?
q1.answer: We review listings to help reduce duplicate, incomplete, or misleading posts. While we aim to maintain listing quality, we recommend that buyers inspect the vehicle and verify all details before making a purchase.

q2.question: Is RutaRide a dealership?
q2.answer: No. RutaRide is a marketplace that connects buyers and renters directly with verified dealers and rental partners. We do not own the vehicles listed on the platform.

q3.question: Can I contact a seller directly?
q3.answer: Yes. Every listing lets you reach out directly to the dealer or seller by phone, WhatsApp, or inquiry form with no middleman markup.

q4.question: Why do some cars have more photos than others?
q4.answer: Dealers and partners upload photos directly for each vehicle. We encourage complete multi-angle galleries, though photo counts vary depending on the seller.

q5.question: How do I know if a car is priced fairly?
q5.answer: You can compare similar makes, models, years, and mileage across multiple dealers in your city on RutaRide to see transparent supplier pricing.

q6.question: What should I check before contacting a seller?
q6.answer: Review the vehicle specifications, model year, mileage, included rental or purchase terms, and pickup location before reaching out to confirm availability.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: This policy describes how RutaRide collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our platform and services.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.p1: RutaRide respects your privacy and is committed to protecting personal information collected from you through our website and mobile application (herein collectively referred to as the “Platform”). This privacy policy governs the way we collect and use information, and by using the services on our Platform (“Services”) you agree to be bound by this policy. All references within this policy to 'we/us/our' refer to <siteLink>rutaride.com</siteLink>. This Privacy Policy is in addition to any other terms and conditions applicable to the Platform. Specific privacy terms contained in any documents made available by us should be read together with this Privacy Policy.
introduction.p2: The Website Policies and Terms & Conditions may be changed or updated occasionally to meet the requirements and standards. Therefore, the Customers’ are encouraged to frequently visit these sections to be updated about the changes on the website. Modifications will be effective on the day they are posted.
introduction.p3: We reserve the right, at our discretion, to modify or remove portions of this Privacy Policy at any time. You should review this Privacy Policy periodically so that you are updated on any changes. We do not make any representations about third party web sites that may be linked to the Platform. Information we collect when you use the Services you will have the option to provide us with personal information, such as your email address, so that we may keep you informed. We use this to provide the Services.

rentalGuide.title: What to look for in your rental
rentalGuide.description: Finding the perfect rental car at the right price doesn't have to be difficult. With RutaRide's "Bid My Price" feature, you can negotiate the rental price instead of simply accepting the listed rate. This gives travelers more flexibility and the opportunity to save money while booking from verified rental operators.

roadRules.title: Road rules worth memorizing
roadRules.description: Speed limits are strictly enforced by camera. Stick within the posted limit plus the small grace buffer, signal every lane change, and never undertake on the right. Roundabouts give way to the left. RutaRide's Bid My Price feature gives customers more control over the car rental process. Instead of accepting fixed prices, you have the opportunity to negotiate a better deal while booking through a trusted marketplace. Search for a vehicle, compare options, make an offer, and complete your booking to get a smoother rental and a better price on your next trip.
